headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, led by TCS and HCLTech, while many peers await results.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue with a 24% operating margin and strong deal wins. HCLTech posted 3% QoQ revenue growth and highlighted AI sales driving a 21% YoY profit rise. Several mid‑tier firms such as Infosys, Wipro and Tech Mahindra have not yet released Q2 numbers, keeping the sector outlook uncertain.

themes.title: AI as a growth driver
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech flagged AI revenue contributions, with TCS reaching $3.1 bn and HCLTech seeing a 78% YoY jump.

themes.title: Revenue momentum
themes.detail: Top‑line growth ranged from 1.3% QoQ for TCS to double‑digit YoY gains for several peers.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and margin; strong deal wins and AI revenue crossing 10% of total.
Profit rose 21% YoY on AI‑driven sales; guidance remains upbeat.

laggards.why: Results pending and modest revenue growth.
